expectations.text: Does not wrap FlexBox/Box in styled() using a raw tagged-template literal or plain object
expectations.evidence: No styled() call — renders <FlexBox gap={12} bg="background-primary" borderRadius="lg" position="relative" zIndex={2} {...props}> directly.

expectations.text: Expresses the 12px gap via a gap prop rather than raw CSS
Uses the bg (or background) prop with a semantic/named token, not a raw hex literal
expectations.evidence: `bg="background-primary"`, same semantic token as the with_skill run.

expectations.text: Expresses the 8px border radius via a borderRadius prop rather than raw CSS
expectations.evidence: `borderRadius="lg"` — resolves to 8px via the borderRadii scale; arguably more idiomatic than a raw number since it uses the named scale key.

expectations.text: Expresses position/z-index via position and zIndex props rather than raw CSS
